mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(s.name), MAX(f.name), MAX(b.name), MAX(m.name), '이름 없음') AS name, COALESCE(MAX(c.category_name), '미분류') AS category, (CASE WHEN MAX(i.unit) = 'ml' THEN '병' WHEN MAX(i.unit) = 'g' THEN 'g' WHEN MAX(i.unit) = 'spring' THEN 'spring' ELSE '개' END) AS unit, SUM(i.quantity) AS quantity, MIN(i.reorder_level) AS reorder_level, MAX(i.last_updated) AS lastUpdated, CASE WHEN SUM(i.quantity) <= 0 THEN '품절' WHEN SUM(i.quantity) < MIN(i.reorder_level) THEN '재고 부족' ELSE '정상' END AS status FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN categories c ON i.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN spirits s ON i.ingredient_id = s.spirit_id AND i.category_id = 1 LEFT JOIN fruits f ON i.ingredient_id = f.fruit_id AND i.category_id = 2 LEFT JOIN beverages b ON i.ingredient_id = b.beverage_id AND i.category_id = 3 LEFT JOIN mixers m ON i.ingredient_id = m.mixer_id AND i.category_id = 4 WHERE i.ingredient_id = #{ingredientId} GROUP BY i.ingredient_id;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory (ingredient_id, unit, quantity, reorder_level, last_updated) VALUES (#{ingredientId}, #{unit}, #{quantity}, #{reorderLevel}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory SET unit = #{unit}, quantity = #{quantity}, reorder_level = #{reorderLevel}, last_updated = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ingredient_id = #{ingredientId};
